def: An open-source framework for RLHF and RL training of LLMs (Hu et al., 2024) built on Ray, vLLM, DeepSpeed and Hugging Face Transformers.
practice: Named alongside veRL and TRL as an open stack for RLVR and large-scale rollouts; its paper reports 1.22x to 1.68x training speedups over comparable frameworks.
